target_customer: Product teams at software companies, mainly fintech and retail, wanting in-app user feedback
problem: Product teams struggle to collect contextual user feedback quickly inside the product journey without building survey tooling.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with SDK-embedded surveys

technical_complexity.rationale: SDK for web and mobile surveys plus targeting and analysis was standard engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Established survey tools and many entrants offered similar in-app surveys, and the SDK was easy to swap.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it away; a conversion optimization vendor, Wingify, bought it in December 2025.

market_need_then: Product teams wanted faster user research and contextual feedback, but no dated 2021 to 2022 source was found to quantify demand.

identity.mascot_or_character: A llama is implied by the name but no source describes a mascot

brand_strength.rationale: Playful compound name but no sourced press or community; SEO blog content existed but nothing shows brand pull.

outcome_analysis: Blitzllama joined YC in Winter 2022 with a small team and a seed reported only by aggregators at about $500K in total. It built the Pulse and Eureka feedback products and was sold to Wingify in an all-cash deal announced in December 2025, with its capabilities merged into VWO. The price is undisclosed and public traction data is thin, so whether this was a strong outcome or a soft landing is unclear.
notes: Seed of 2022-03 reported by Seedtable (YC, 2am VC, Magic Fund) and CB Insights ($500K across two rounds, which may include the acquisition entry); single aggregators, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Company website blitzllama.com returned 404 on fetch. No dated 2021 to 2022 competitor source found; search returned only 2026 comparison articles. Completeness pass: The 2022-03 seed rests on a single database (Seedtable); a cross-check search did not confirm the investors, and CB Insights total of 500K over 2 rounds is not reconciled.
